editorial:
Imagine being a famous race car driver who has everything, only to find out your partner is cheating on you. That is where you meet Pierre, a guy who hits rock bottom fast. Just as he is about to give up on everything, a sweet flight attendant he once ignored pops up to save him. The catch? She is actually his guardian angel in disguise. It is a lighthearted mix of love and magic that feels like a warm hug. You will love the chemistry between the leads and the funny way Pierre tries to deny that angels even exist while one is standing right in front of him.

The acting is charming and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling rushed. While some of the older effects are a bit dated, the heart of the story is what really counts. If you enjoy old-school romance with a supernatural twist, you should definitely give this a try. It is best enjoyed as a cozy night in.
endingExplained: As the story wraps up, Pierre finally accepts that the angel is real and that he has fallen in love with her. However, since she is a divine being, she cannot stay on Earth forever. After helping Pierre find his will to live and his passion for racing again, she has to return to heaven. They share a bittersweet goodbye, but Pierre is left as a changed man, happier and more hopeful about his future.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic romances and stories about second chances.
